items.description: Leading full-stack development of enterprise platforms. Driving the adoption of AI-powered features — LLM integrations, semantic search and RAG-based assistants — alongside core product engineering with Next.js, Node.js and AWS.

Consulted on national-scale government and enterprise systems, including TAMM — the Abu Dhabi Government services platform — and cross-platform mobile products built with React Native and NestJS on Azure.
Built marketplace and media platforms end to end on the MERN stack with NestJS — job marketplaces, video platforms with paid content, and serverless fintech systems on AWS.

Owned multiple client projects simultaneously in the web team, handling direct client communication. Led projects from e-commerce and booking platforms to ed-tech, and built Unity 3D web games including accessible games for children with visual impairments.
Owned a full product lifecycle early in my career — an events/learning platform and a taxi-bidding marketplace — using Angular, Java Spring and MongoDB.
